map.样品量×硅胶比: Sample mass x silica gel ratio
map.样品 1 g、硅胶比 30:1 → 硅胶 30 g；硅胶堆密度≈0.5 g/mL: Sample 1 g with a 30:1 silica gel ratio gives 30 g of silica gel; silica gel bulk density is about 0.5 g/mL so the volume is 60 mL (about 60 BV).
map.柱径 3 cm、半径 1.5 cm；柱高=60/(π×1.5²)=60/7.07: Column diameter 3 cm gives a radius of 1.5 cm; column height = 60/(pi x 1.5^2) = 60/7.07 is about 8.5 cm, a reasonable packing range.
map.硅胶比怎么定？: How is the silica gel ratio chosen?
map.常规 30~100:1（样品:硅胶），难分离取大值。: The routine range is 30-100:1 (sample:silica gel); take the larger value for difficult separations.
map.柱体积（bed volume），洗脱体积常以 BV 计，1 BV≈硅胶堆体积。: Bed volume; elution volume is often expressed in BV, and 1 BV is about the bulk volume of the silica gel.
